metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds four uses of the word king, the Rose yard, and a looking-glass.

yesterday: The margin is written. Not every king a crown. Some are only a cough.
You stood in the Rose yard for Hercules. The flag was up.
Henslowe pays by the play. Six pound, and he never argues the jig. You are paid by the share.
The looking-glass is yours. Tomorrow is a writing day. The king is still only down.
